page.layout: One column of running text; in the left margin two marginal notes (year note and a note on the broken treaty); running head at the top; page number at the top right.
page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf,

main_text.p: giùs paulatim tendere, & à pactis recede-re, & civitatis jura arctare deprehenderetur Geldrus, à Marwico prætore primùm incitatus, cui simultas cum senatu intercedebat, deinde irritatus, quod, bello pro Balthasaro Esensi in FrisiâOrientali contra Ennonem Comitem vicinum suscep-to, in ejus impensas tributum sibi à civitate negaretur, & suapte naturâ potentiæ per fas & nefas augendæ avidus, & turbulentus, occasione raptâ, quam fors offerebat,An.M.D. xxxvi. per Meinhardum Hammen-fem clarum militiâ virum, Daniæ regis auspicia profitentem, occultisCarolus Geldrus pacta vio-lata. mandatis suis instructum, adductis copiis tumultus in agro, & ad ipsas portas urbis cieret, suburbia vastaret & incenderet, Dammonam summâ festinatione muniret, postremo in colloquio Essenæ componendæ rei causâ instituto per Henricum Grovium Erclenii dominum legatum suum, & Hacfordum militum præfectum palàm jam posceret, arcem munitam in urbe sibi extrui, Dammonæque munitiones perfici, civitas merito ab eo animis alienata, ad partes Burgundicas se vertit.

page.notes: Printed text is set in a single column; the page is otherwise clean. Doubtful readings: "Esensi" (printed Efensi, reading of the first letters uncertain); "FrisiâOrientali" is printed without a space and is copied as such; the page number "152" is read from a worn figure; the running head "Frif." and "Amaf," are copied as printed. Marginal "vio-lata" is a hyphenated word whose second part is partly obscured. The year note is printed on two lines ("An.M.D." / "xxxvi.") and is given as one note.
